The design of record is the batch #147 item 2 ruling on the parent (comment 5715762696), reproduced here only where this layer needs it.

## Scope (the frontend layer — `domain:ui`, this repo)

Phase 1 needs nothing here: the runtime serves select fields with resolved `options`, so renderers, validation and filters are unchanged. Phase 2, this card: (1) a Studio **picklist page** — list, create, edit the package-owned picklists the runtime exposes (name, label, options with per-option label; extensions shown read-only with their owning package); (2) in the object designer's select-field editor, **「use picklist」** — pick a picklist by name instead of typing inline options, mutually exclusive with inline options (the spec refuses both); (3) the console pin bump that carries the spec/runtime halves, read by REST `compare` before this card is dispatched (pin lag is the cross-repo unlock criterion: 「消费方可安装」).

## Acceptance

A studio-authoring checklist item (authored here): create a picklist, reference it from two objects' select fields, add an option, both objects' forms show it without a rebuild; the designer refuses inline options on a field that references a picklist. `pnpm objectui:refresh` flows the build back to objectstack per the multi-repo rule.
